# Nature

> Nature is a premier peer-reviewed scientific journal and digital platform publishing cutting-edge research across biology, physics, climate science, and medicine.

Nature.com hosts the latest research articles, news briefings, and analysis from Nature Portfolio journals including specialized publications in cancer research, dentistry, and pharmacology. The platform serves as a central hub for scientific discovery, featuring both primary research and expert commentary on breakthroughs in genome editing, artificial intelligence, climate science, and neurobiology.

## Key Topics

- genome editing
- artificial intelligence
- climate science
- CRISPR-Cas9
- CAR-T cell immunotherapy
- quantum computing
- static electricity
- charge transfer
- gut-brain signaling
- blood-brain barrier
- Nature Portfolio
- peer-reviewed research
- scientific publications
- molecular biology
- materials science

## Current Research & Issues

- [Volume 651 Issue 8106, 19 March 2026](https://www.nature.com/nature/current-issue): Current issue of Nature journal with research highlights and editorial
- [Reviews & Analysis](https://www.nature.com/nature/reviews-and-analysis): Nature's research reviews and analysis across genome editing and climate
- [Latest science news, discoveries and analysis](https://www.nature.com/news): Aggregated breaking science news and research analysis from Nature

## Biotechnology & Medicine

- [CRISPR makes enhanced cancer-fighting immune cells inside mice](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-00857-6): CRISPR-Cas9 enables safer CAR-T cell creation for cancer immunotherapy
- [Genome editing that avoids immune detection to integrate large DNA sequences](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-00730-6): Novel genome editing approach enables large DNA integration without toxicity
- [Intestinal interoceptive dysfunction drives age-associated cognitive decline](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-026-10191-6): Gut-brain signaling pathway links microbiome changes to aging memory loss
- [Brain's protective barrier stays leaky for years after playing contact sports](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-00885-2): Blood-brain barrier damage linked to cognitive decline after head trauma

## Physics & Materials Science

- [Static electricity is a big mystery — a jolt of fresh research could help to solve it](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-00837-w): Triboelectric effect research unravels mysteries of static electricity physics
- [Leading the charge to explain static electricity](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-00839-8): Researchers advance understanding of static electricity and charge transfer
- [Hair-raising: how carbon contamination can drive static charging](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-00631-8): Carbon-based surface contamination explains static charge differences
- [Major Turing computing award goes to quantum science for first time](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-00818-z): Turing Award honors Brassard and Bennett for quantum computing breakthroughs

## Climate & Environment

- [AI set to map risks of future climate disasters](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-00835-y): AI-powered early warning systems for climate disasters in Brazil and China
- [Climate snapshots trapped in ancient ice tell a surprising story](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-00636-3): Antarctic ice cores reveal ocean role in past three million years of climate
- [Affordable mobility for all: why we need smaller, cheaper electric vehicles](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-00779-3): Low-speed electric vehicles offer sustainable and affordable transportation
